overview_description.description:
Truepill is a B2B pharmacy fulfillment service. They provide a pharmacy API and fulfillment of medications to 50 states from their own facilities. They work directly with D2C consumer brands (e.g. Hims, Nurx), digital health companies, and other healthcare organizations. They are a team of 150 employees and have raised funding from Initialized Capital, Y Combinator, Slow Ventures, Sound Ventures, Tuesday Capital, Foundation Capital, Index Ventures, Social Capital, Box Group, Joe Montana, and others.

Founded in 2016 by Umar Afridi and Sid Viswanathan, Truepill is headquartered in San Mateo, California.

product.name: Pharmacy APIs
product.description: RESTful APIs providing real-time access to patient, prescription, and order data for integration into digital pharmacy workflows.

product.name: Virtual Pharmacy
product.description: A pre-built, configurable digital pharmacy platform that can be white-labeled to deliver a full pharmacy experience.

product.name: Pharmacy Fulfillment
product.description: Nationwide mail order and specialty pharmacy services for dispensing and shipping medications to patients.

product.name: Patient Services
product.description: Pharmacist support and patient engagement services including prescription intake, transfer, renewal, insurance processing, and fulfillment assistance.

product.name: Patient Safety API
product.description: APIs that support patient safety by managing allergy, condition, and medication data and performing drug utilization reviews.

product.name: Prior Authorization API
product.description: API to manage prior authorization requests for medications requiring insurer approval before coverage.
